name: Fortune Cats Golden Stacks!!

features.name: Extra play areas
features.description: Up to 120 lines in the bonus.

review:
Fortune Cats Golden Stacks is a 40-line Asian slot with mystery symbols and golden stacks. Its bonus adds more play areas, raising the line count to 120.

Thunderkick lists a 96.14% RTP and a 2,500x cap, and publishes a numeric volatility figure rather than a label.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Thunderkick doesn't publish a volatility label for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
